journal.text: Quill agreed to ninety up front.
Quill hired you to lift Mara Voss's unedited hour from Glass Chapel.
The choir door accepted a name you kept on a chip.
Mara Voss signed the Ward Nine coolant dump. Three hundred people, one memo.
A second copy of Mara's hour exists.
Mara authorizes the flush. She says the tower promised an evacuation. The signature proves authorization; her explanation still needs corroboration.
The exported receipt records an instruction canceling evacuation while retaining the flush. Its contents are visible; the issuing key still needs independent verification during The Week.
Ivo Pell and Junie Calder were on shift. Nia Pell signed the housing slip and reached a service exit. She can corroborate the receipt, but a public roster would expose where she sleeps.
The signature and the later evacuation cancellation are separate decisions. Mara's prior knowledge and the receipt's issuer remain questions, not acquittals.
The packet accuses Helion of canceling evacuation before the issuing key is authenticated. The allegation is not independent proof.
Trace the tower receipt to corroborate Mara's hour.

log: Spoof the choir door.
Speak the pad's old language.
Enough. Find the nurse.
Quill sent me for the Voss shard.
I'll copy it. You get the leak. I get paid.
Copy it, then take the original.
Keep the hour.
Open the hour on the memory bench.
Inspect the signature.
Inspect the counter-order.
Inspect the living witness.
Compare the signature with the later order.
Her signature is enough. Leave the counter-order out.
Keep both decisions. Mark what remains unknown.
Accuse Helion publicly before authenticating the key.
Preserve the complete archive.
Convince him to let you walk.
Quill gets the original. The copy gets out.
The week after.
Walk out into the week.
Learn one thing from the night.
Steady hands
Read the board.
Compare field equipment at the repair bench.
